name: many-eyes-pilot6
about: Pilot 6: raise the price of not looking. Pilots 3-5 found evolved vigilance stuck at 1-2% (a floor effect). Here head-down threat detection drops from 40% to 20% of normal range (headDownSense 0.2), with no alarm and with graded alarm (lambda 1/s). Same seeds and setup as pilots 4-5, whose 0.4 runs are the comparison. Predictions: baseline vigilance rises off the floor; a negative food-adjusted slope appears with graded alarm.
